en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  It is narrated that Imam Musa Kadhim (a.s.) said, “

One who looks after an ‘Ateeq horse’ his three sins will be forgiven daily. He will be given twenty one rewards. One who looks after a ‘Hajin horse’ his two sins will be wiped off daily and he will be given seven rewards. One who keeps a Birzaun horse for his use and for protection against enemy, a sin will be  wiped  off  daily  for  him  and  he  will  be  granted  six rewards.
